reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual re-review of external-02 against the exact native source, enlarged source page 06, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, targeted native-resolution face and note crops, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference; prior external-01 review files were left unchanged

remaining_reasons: The source visibly has a high receding hairline with very short dark-brown hair around the crown and sides. External-02 removes all visible hair and leaves a completely smooth bald yellow head. Restore the source's short crown/side hair without changing the repaired note.
The source's dark eyebrows are clearly visible, but external-02 has no eyebrows above either eye. Restore the source-scale dark eyebrows while preserving the repaired note.
entries.positive_observation: The requested note repair is visibly successful: exactly two compact upper gray-mark rows remain, with two small marks per row, no third row or lower-left dash, and largely blank lower paper. The full tilted frame, opaque gray-olive photographic backing, warm-cream note and right-edge tab remain. The nearly frontal slightly left-facing pose, single closed mouth, clean-shaven chin, lack of glasses, red/gold collar patches, gold shoulder trim, pale blue-white ribbon and single silver-toned cross remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad collar, and full white/cyan comparisons show no visible holes, lost backing or working-matte ring. These positives do not offset the new clearly visible hair and eyebrow losses.
entries.visible_limitations: Exact collar/pendant symbols and the finest hairline pixels are not readable at 65x67, and note glyphs are not readable text. Those uncertainties are not rejection reasons; complete hair removal and missing dark eyebrows are clearly visible in the native crop.
